contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS] ; D/ CONSTAN [ ] IVN NC

Copper alloy Nummus, Constans (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows: Two soldiers and one standard. Mint: Trier AD 335 - 341. Obverse legend reads: CONSTAN [ ] IVN NC. Obverse shows: Laureate cuirassed bust facing right. Die Axis: 6 o'clock
